subject.title: Feature: config-level default task notify policy

question: Should OpenClaw add a public config-level default task notify policy, and should that surface be a single default or a per-runtime map for ACP, subagent, cron, CLI, and Task Flow records?
rationale: The source-repro is clear, but choosing the durable config path affects message delivery volume and long-term config compatibility, which automation should not decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add per-runtime defaults
options.body: Introduce a schema-backed default resolver that keeps current unset behavior and allows targeted overrides for ACP/subagent without changing cron/CLI/media defaults.

options.title: Add one global default
options.body: Expose one simpler default policy and rely on explicit runtime callers to preserve existing special cases where needed.

options.title: Decline the config surface
options.body: Keep hardcoded runtime defaults and handle remaining pain through narrower channel-specific or runtime-specific issues.

recommendation.title: Add per-runtime defaults
recommendation.body: Introduce a schema-backed default resolver that keeps current unset behavior and allows targeted overrides for ACP/subagent without changing cron/CLI/media defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to task docs, config defaults, Task Flow, and ACP spawn paths, which span the product/config decision.
